vacuum_thermal_lab.why_zh: 先在地面把设备冻住、烤透、抽成真空。这比把人送上去便宜几个数量级。
vacuum_thermal_lab.why_en: Freeze, bake, and evacuate hardware on the ground. It is orders of magnitude cheaper than discovering the same flaw in flight.

analog_operations.why_zh: 南极、沙漠、封闭舱。先学会怎么失败才不会在真空里失败。
analog_operations.why_en: Antarctica, desert, sealed chambers. Learn how the crew fails before vacuum makes it fatal.

closed_water_93.zh: 水循环 93%（空间站早期水平）
closed_water_93.why_zh: 国际空间站在卤水处理器之前大约是 93–94%。这是载人远航的最低门槛，不是殖民地门槛。
closed_water_93.why_en: ISS was about 93–94% before the brine processor. This is the floor for a long crew flight, not the settlement floor.

closed_water_98.why_zh: NASA 把约 98% 当作远程任务的目标。做不到，补给质量会吃掉发射能力。
closed_water_98.why_en: NASA treats about 98% as the long-mission target. Miss it and resupply mass eats the launch manifest.

sabatier.why_zh: 二氧化碳加氢生成水和甲烷。氢来自电解，所以氧回收率被化学计量卡住，现行大约 47%，目标 75% 以上。
sabatier.why_en: CO2 plus hydrogen makes water and methane. Hydrogen comes from electrolysis, so oxygen recovery is stoichiometry-limited: about 47% demonstrated as a program figure, goal above 75%.

crop_lab.why_zh: 热量是卡路里，不是生菜照片。照明电力会主导栖息地功率。
crop_lab.why_en: Calories, not lettuce photos. Lighting power will dominate the habitat power budget.

simulant_biology.why_zh: 高氯酸盐、尘埃、紫外。先在模拟物里活过 90 天，再谈月球或火星温室。
simulant_biology.why_en: Perchlorates, dust, ultraviolet. Ninety days in simulant before anyone talks about a lunar or Martian greenhouse.

launch_abort.why_zh: 上升段出事时，逃逸系统决定乘员是事故还是葬礼。
launch_abort.why_en: On the way up, an abort system is the difference between an accident and a funeral.

precision_robotics.zh: 精确机器人着陆与作业
precision_robotics.why_zh: 机器先于人类。它们不怕真空，但怕尘埃、黑夜和没有备件。
precision_robotics.why_en: Machines before people. They tolerate vacuum and fail from dust, night, and no spare parts.

lunar_isru_pilot.why_zh: LCROSS 在卡比厄斯坑测到约 5.6% 的水冰。试点要证明能采，不是引用那篇论文。
lunar_isru_pilot.why_en: LCROSS measured about 5.6% water ice at Cabeus. A pilot has to mine it, not cite the paper.

storm_shelter.why_zh: 银河宇宙线是慢性的。太阳高能粒子是急性的。掩体是睡觉的地方，也是风暴时的地方。
storm_shelter.why_en: Galactic cosmic rays are chronic. Solar energetic particles are acute. The shelter is where the crew sleeps, and where they hide.

kilopower.why_zh: KRUSTY/Kilopower 是千瓦级。月球夜和火星尘暴会杀死纯光伏栖息地。
kilopower.why_en: KRUSTY/Kilopower is the kilowatt class. Lunar night and Martian dust storms kill solar-only habitats.

buried_habitat.why_zh: 辐射防护来自质量。月球和火星最便宜的质量是脚下的土。
buried_habitat.why_en: Radiation shielding is mass. The cheapest mass on the Moon or Mars is the ground underfoot.

heavy_edl.zh: 重型火星进入减速着陆
heavy_edl.why_zh: 已有的成功着陆大约是一吨级。人的着陆器是几十吨。没有这项，载人登陆在物理上不成立。
heavy_edl.why_en: Successful landings to date are about a tonne. A crewed lander is tens of tonnes. Without this, a crewed landing is physically unavailable.

moxie_scale.why_zh: MOXIE 一共制造了 122 克氧气。人一天就要约 0.9 千克。中间差着四个数量级的运行时间。
moxie_scale.why_en: MOXIE made 122 grams of oxygen in total. A person needs about 0.9 kg a day. The gap is continuous operation, not a press release.

industrial_isru.why_zh: 返回地球的氧化剂以吨计。先在月球上学会采水，再在火星上放大制氧。
industrial_isru.why_en: Return oxidizer is measured in tonnes. Learn to mine water on the Moon, then scale oxygen on Mars.

ntr_stage.why_zh: DRA 5.0 的核热火箭比冲约 900–910 秒，用来把战役质量压进 800–1200 吨的低地轨道初始质量。它没有飞行过。
ntr_stage.why_en: DRA 5.0's nuclear thermal stage is about 900–910 s Isp, the reason a campaign can fit in an 800–1200 t IMLEO band. It has not flown.

offworld_obstetrics.why_zh: 不能生育的前哨不是火种。这一项不保证安全，只表示你建了医疗能力并接受辐射剂量约束。
offworld_obstetrics.why_en: An outpost that cannot have children is not a seed. This tech does not make birth safe. It builds the medical capability and accepts the dose constraint.

genome_bank.why_zh: 史密斯 2014 的数量级是没有种质库时需要上万人。一百个活人加上大型档案，才是一颗骰子，而不是一个瓶颈。
genome_bank.why_en: Smith 2014 is tens of thousands of people if there is no bank. A hundred living humans plus a large archive is a die to throw, not a bottleneck pretending to be a species.

local_manufacturing.why_zh: 断供五年的含义是：生命保障、电源和压力容器的备件不必从地球来。
local_manufacturing.why_en: Five years without resupply means spare parts for life support, power, and pressure vessels are made locally.

reusable_super_heavy.zh: 可重复使用超重型运载
reusable_super_heavy.why_zh: 设计目标级的运载，不是已证实的航班表现。可靠性在游戏里低于成熟重型火箭，直到你飞出统计。
reusable_super_heavy.why_en: A design-target launcher, not a demonstrated flight rate. In this game its reliability stays below mature heavy lift until you fly the statistics.

high_energy_transfer.why_zh: 可以不等 26 个月，但质量比会惩罚你。窗口仍然是便宜的路。
high_energy_transfer.why_en: You can refuse the 26-month wait. The rocket equation charges for it. The window is still the cheap road.
